notes: Native WebGPU/TSL sample with an RTX ray-lighting enhancement and a truthful raster fallback.
Relief is a project-owned luminance, edge and center-prior heuristic; it is not neural inference or metric depth.
Camera permission is requested only after C is pressed or ?live=1 is supplied; staged procedural RGBA is the default.
Current relief and four frozen temporal echo sheets share one fixed-topology dynamic BLAS.
No model weights, third-party inference library, downloaded asset, font, style sheet or HTML UI is used.
